workdir.description: Directory where pgcopydb stores its state, logs, and temporary files.

source.description: PostgreSQL connection URI for the source database.

target.description: PostgreSQL connection URI for the target database.

parallel_jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs to copy table data.

parallel_index_jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs to create indexes after data copy.

test_decoding_plugin.description: The logical decoding output plugin to use for streaming changes (test_decoding or wal2json).

skip_roles.description: If true, skip copying database roles from source to target.

excluded_schemas.description: List of schema names to exclude from the copy operation.

excluded_tables.description: List of table names (schema.table) to exclude from the copy operation.

log_level.description: Log verbosity level: info, debug, or trace.
